newsitem.title: UK: Shell extends gains on Warburg upgrades.
newsitem.headline: Shell extends gains on Warburg upgrades.

text.p: Shares in Shell Transport and Trading Co Plc extended their opening late in the morning session on Friday as SBC Warburg upgraded the stock, dealers said.
By 0955 GMT, the shares were up 18p to 1073-1/2 in active trading. More than 4.39 million shares changed hands, making it the second most heavily traded stock in London.
SBC Warburg said it had raised its rating to "add" from "hold," saying it looked cheap compared with other major oil companies in the sector.
Dresdner Kleinwort Benson said it was repeating its bullish stance, as well.
Earlier, ABN Amro Hoare Govett repeated "buy" advice on the stock, citing a strong reserve replacement figure in the 1996 annual report.
ABN Amro Hoare Govett was targeting 1200p for the share price. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
